This thing was more for me to try and articulate my thoughts because my head goes at a million mph all the time and it’s hard to really get a bearing. If you’re worried about anyone who’s struggling, pop a message, sometimes they’re too scared to reach out themselves, believe me.

Like I’m not strolling around at night and standing in the road at 3am anymore, but I ain’t really 100% because my mood will change by the minute. So I dunno where I stand really. I had counselling so I feel like I’m more aware of who I am but it’s now battling my head.

Like seriously, one minute I’m top of the world, love everyone and I’m on cracking form and the next I could be having a panic attack and asking to be put down. I don’t feel like I’m in control really but I ain’t as bad as I was in the winter when I was full on wanting to die.

I keep a lot of my negative shit away from public now but that doesn’t mean it’s all been plain sailing, it’s been the opposite really. It’s still been rough, I still have panic attacks daily, and my mood fluctuates minute to minute, which is a bit shit.
